verdict.rationale: Exa's Contents API is documented to return clean page content from URLs, including JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs and complex layouts. Search can return the same page content for result URLs in one request, at no extra charge for up to 10 results, so developers get more than snippets. missing for 10: an explicit full-text parameter and markdown output format are never named in the evidence (the docs emphasize excerpts/highlights), and there is no independent hands-on confirmation that full-page content is returned.
